thought.text: The serve process (PID 1209) is still running. Let me kill it by specific PID.

reasoning_content: The serve process (PID 1209) is still running — the pkill command exited with 143 (SIGTERM). This probably means it also killed the shell. Let me try killing the specific PID 1209.

action.command: kill 1209; sleep 2; ps aux | grep -E "serve build" | grep -v grep; echo "exit:$?"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "port3000:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null || echo "port3000: free (no server)"
